response.sql: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ReportsTo), shares AS (SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, 1.0 * employee_count / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share FROM group_counts) SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference FROM shares ORDER BY share_difference DESC LIMIT 10;
